items.title: A Year And Millions. Now Done In Six Weeks.
items.summary: In episode 1021 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, @JonKrohnLearns talks with Tristan Handy, CEO and founder of DBT Labs, the company behind, you guessed it, DBT, which is the beloved open source tool that brought software engineering rigor to data transformation, as Tristan explains how 12KB 'skill files' empower AI agents to flawlessly execute complex DBT migrations in six weeks, a task that previously cost millions and took years. He likens skill files to downloading new skills into an agent's brain, enabling them to absorb decades of DBT training and certifications. This capability allows organizations to migrate thousands of tables from legacy systems to DBT rapidly and cost-effectively, transforming a high-risk, time-intensive process into a streamlined operation.
